method: STRIDE pass by the execute agent over tenant isolation, sandbox minting and privacy (an independent reviewer is scheduled by the orchestrator)

scenarios.scenario: Spoof another sandbox by editing the cookie w/a claims
scenarios.rationale: HMAC-verified cookie (verifyCookie, constant-time); forged or mixed w/a -> 401 (sandbox-isolation); analyst must belong to the workspace (liveness JOIN)

scenarios.scenario: Bind a cookie to ws_demo to write into the demo
scenarios.rationale: liveness requires kind='sandbox' (401 even for a correctly signed ws_demo cookie); demo write-block triggers outside seed_mode (demo-workspace-not-polluted)

scenarios.scenario: Edit or delete a past decision or audit row
scenarios.rationale: decision_guard_update lists every immutable column; append-only triggers on decision/audit/answer; only the 'purging' state allows DELETE (triggers, decision-append-only, audit-trail-append-only)

scenarios.scenario: Forge memory by sending a fingerprint that does not match the quote
scenarios.rationale: server recomputes the fingerprint from quote_text with the run's firm -> 422 (decision-record-contract)
exactly one audit row per write op, inserted first in the same atomic batch, with actor name, time and reason (audit-trail-append-only)

scenarios.scenario: Read another workspace's or firm's memory through any route or the RulesPort
scenarios.rationale: every statement binds workspace_id from the cookie (statement lint + inline-SQL lint); composite FKs; RulesPort is workspace-bound (memory-no-cross-firm-or-workspace, rules-port-scoped)

scenarios.scenario: Leak sensitive numbers or finding facts into server storage
scenarios.rationale: detail never persisted (R1); maskFree on every free-text field; masked before truncation; full quote dropped after hashing (memory-storage-contract with canaries and 9-digit runs)

scenarios.scenario: Client-chosen ids (finding_ref, client_op_id, pattern_key) carry raw account numbers into storage
scenarios.rationale: ids are stored unmasked (finding_ref <= 64 chars, client_op_id <= 64, pattern_key restricted to [a-z0-9:#>-]). LOW: they are client-generated identifiers, never displayed as text; Phase 08 client must generate them from engine ids only. Recorded as a non-blocking residual.

scenarios.scenario: Mint sandboxes in a loop to burn the D1 write budget
scenarios.rationale: session_new caps (5 per IP hash/day, 300 global/day ~ 25% of rows/day budget, from S9), Turnstile when configured, read-only degrade over the global cap (session-cookie-workerd)

scenarios.scenario: Flood memory read routes (no in-isolate pre-limit on memory routes)
scenarios.rationale: LOW residual: memory routes require a valid sandbox cookie and are bounded per request (<= 200 fingerprints, <= 50 findings, body caps); there is no per-minute limiter on memory reads (D1 Free 5M rows read/day). Candidate follow-up: reuse the 04a pre-limiter for memory routes (Phase 08/10).
worst endpoint 10 queries, session with purge slot 29, AI worst path 9 queries + 2 fetches (query-budget); remote S8 showed fetches, not D1 queries, hit the 50 limit

scenarios.scenario: Make AI reachable before Phase 05 via the new D1 wiring
scenarios.rationale: with D1 wired and no TURNSTILE_SECRET, /api/ai and /api/ocr refuse before any claim or upstream call whether or not OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set (ai-fail-closed-without-secrets)

scenarios.scenario: Purge deletes the demo or a live sandbox
scenarios.rationale: purge marks only kind='sandbox' AND expires_at <= now; CHECK keeps demo 'active'; demo delete trigger; single atomic batch (memory-retention-purge-test)
